name: CFX MoveUSD
oneLiner: MOVEUSD is CFX's Solana bank-deposit dollar token backed 1:1 by USD deposits in beneficiary accounts at FDIC-insured banks.
collateral: U.S. dollar deposits held 1:1 in beneficiary accounts at participating FDIC-insured banks for approved CFX customers.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route for approved CFX customers, with MOVEUSD intended to settle one-to-one against bank deposits rather than a Treasury reserve portfolio.

applicabilityBasis.summary: MOVEUSD is a CFX-issued dollar token for payment and settlement flows, redeemable through designated channels for approved customers.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators; Metropolitan Capital Bank & Trust banking partner context
genius.notes: MOVEUSD public materials describe CFX issuance and designated redemption channels, but Pharos found no public GENIUS issuer intent, PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source. CFX's July 30 2025 press release describes MOVEUSD as 'GENIUS-ready' (first on Ethereum and Base), framing this as architectural alignment with reserve and redemption requirements — this is marketing language, not a formal PPSI pathway announcement, and does not meet the bar for issuer-announced-intent. The original reserveDisclosureUrl (docs.moveusd.com/docs/disclosures-disclaimers) now redirects to docs.cfx.to with no dedicated reserve disclosure page found; reserveDisclosurePresent updated to false accordingly.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS issuer intent, token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for MOVEUSD. CFX's 'GENIUS-ready' marketing claim describes architectural alignment, not a regulatory pathway.

sources.label: CFX launches MoveUSD PR Newswire (2025-04-01; re-opened 2026-07-28)

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 (HTTP 200): cfx.to still states CFX-issued digital assets are redeemable 1:1 for U.S. dollars with USD custody by FDIC Member Banks, and the site footer disclaimer states that U.S. dollar deposits collateralizing CFX Labs's USD-based digital dollar MoveUSD are held in a beneficiary account by an FDIC Member Bank. Independently hosted PR Newswire launch copy (2025-04-01) still states every MoveUSD dollar is backed 1:1 and held in beneficiary accounts at participating FDIC-insured banks. CoinMarketCap's MoveUSD about independently describes a U.S. dollar bank-deposit token backed 1:1 by U.S. dollar deposits held with regulated partner banks, with reserves maintained in demand deposit accounts. The former docs.moveusd.com disclosures path still redirects to docs.cfx.to; docs.cfx.to/docs/key-features does not state reserve composition, and disclosures/reserves paths return 404. No named bank, account-level terms, liquidity terms, or dated independent reserve-to-liability report were found. The 100% bank-deposit slice is retained with counterparty/custody/concentration risk factors and unknown liquidity horizon.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: CFX issuer site + independently hosted launch PR + CMC bank-deposit description of MoveUSD USD deposit backing
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The single disclosed reserve category is known, but CFX does not identify the FDIC member bank, publish account-level terms, or provide a dated independent reserve report.

mintAuthority.summary: Finalized Solana state at slot 432837826 sets the MOVEUSD SPL mint and freeze authorities to the mint address, an off-curve program-derived address. Finalized transaction 4G6Asw...PE4wH3 at slot 432775304 proves that the executable program EmiytJ3z...oiA1KC can sign for that PDA and invoke MintToChecked. MOVEUSD therefore has an active, concentrated program-controlled mint route rather than a burned authority.

controls.label: MOVEUSD Solana mint program
controls.evidence: Finalized transaction 4G6Asw...PE4wH3 at Solana slot 432775304 invokes program EmiytJ3zWX9koH3emPsWDEs9RqNm6NNFp4CkMLoiA1KC, whose Mint instruction successfully calls SPL Token MintToChecked for 50 MOVEUSD with 3AdhVEX6...aeC2qm as mintAuthority. Other finalized transactions on 2026-07-14 show the same program minting and burning MOVEUSD. The mint address is off-curve, so these successful CPI calls prove it is a live program-controlled PDA, not a burned signer.

controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432839398, upgradeable-loader ProgramData DybKXmycEuZDF4u8EVxr21Ljza9dEHKF6CKJ9G91zMMY for program EmiytJ3z...oiA1KC named 6fTsNdopg4K5nFBFoBhfiU7GnaEkVa3cvxHoVc1Q9Rw1 as upgrade authority. At slot 432840439 the authority was an on-curve, zero-data system account, not an on-chain multisig or timelock, so it can replace the mint program without an observed delay.

review.evidence: Finalized chain state keeps the SPL mint and freeze authorities self-referential, but the address is an off-curve PDA and finalized 2026-07-14 transactions prove program EmiytJ3z...oiA1KC actively signs for it to mint and burn MOVEUSD. The program is upgradeable: ProgramData DybKXmyc...1zMMY names 6fTsNdop...Q9Rw1 as upgrade authority at slot 432839398. CFX's public product materials describe issuer-managed minting and redemption, while Wormhole describes MOVEUSD as a CFX-controlled multichain burn-and-mint token. The prior directMintAbility none and fixed-supply conclusion were contradicted by current on-chain execution.
